evidence: Name/slug: task.toml:5 `name = "turing/hireops-recruiting-operations"`; the logical task directory is projects/hireops-recruiting-operations/hireops-recruiting-operations (snapshot dir 'task' is not an identity defect per assignment), so name == turing/<dirname> and org is turing. Description (task.toml:6) 'Recruiting workspace with a shared pipeline board and recruiter-candidate conversations that stay correct and usable while several people work at once.' matches instruction.md:1 ('build HireOps, the workspace our recruiting team lives in... pipeline board for each job... conversation attached to each application... Several of us have it open at once') and names the real axis (concurrency). Keywords (task.toml:7) recruiting/pipeline/messaging/realtime/webdev/turing/full-stack all map to the brief (realtime = instruction.md:5 fifteen-second live updates; messaging = conversations) and retain the template's webdev/turing/full-stack. Metadata: difficulty 'hard'; difficulty_explanation enumerates one-step moves, interview capacity, role rules, stale-move refusal naming the colleague, all-or-nothing bulk moves, undo only while untouched, per-person unread and seen, paged history keeping place, drafts surviving reload and sign-out, live updates not disturbing typing/focus/scroll, candidate isolation from staff data -- each item is present in instruction.md:3-9 and hireops_rules.md sections 3 (Moving a card, Interview places, Who may move what, Two people at once, Moving several together, Undo), 5, 6 (Long conversations, Unread, Seen, Drafts) and 7. category 'programming' and tags equal the template values; provenance ('Adapted from the supplied HireOps task as a recruiting workspace, with an authored reference implementation and browser rubric') and arena_slice 'recruiting-hiring-operations' are consistent with the product. tests/app_context.md:3 'Name: HireOps' agrees. No CHANGE_ME placeholder from the template task.toml survives. [task].version absent, which is allowed (staged-task-contract.md:77; workbook row note). Adversarial probes: (a) a task.toml copied from another task (e.g. a stale name/description from the earlier Colderwater work in git history) would fail this row -- none of its identity strings mention anything but HireOps/recruiting; (b) a mismatched slug would fail -- name and directory agree exactly. Minor observations, not defects: the description says 'recruiter-candidate conversations' while hiring managers also join their own jobs' conversations (hireops_rules.md section 6 'Who takes part'), which matches the brief's own framing ('recruiters talk to those candidates'); staged-task-contract.md:42 comments that the description may also mention judge and dimension policy, but the workbook row and quality-checks.md only require the product and its actual axes, so its absence is not a defect. This row is static; no runtime measurement is required for it, and this verdict says nothing about Oracle, model or portal scores.
